pull:
**Pull request #1604 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #1604: Patch: a watcher whose reconnects run out can retry by hand

Closes #1570

Implemented #1570 as planned: when the watch screen's automatic reopens run out on a still-running game, it now offers a "Reconnect now" button — `link-button` on the board's status line beside the existing `watch-status` span, `button-primary` in the waiting panel beside "Back to Play together". Clicking it resets the attempt counter to zero and reopens `/ws/watch`, so the live view resumes on the next frame; a finished or refused game never shows it, and the auto-retrying UI is unchanged.

What changed (exactly the five planned files): [WatchRoute.tsx](/absolute/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1570/apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx) (`useWatch` returns `reconnect` via a ref set by the effect, new `ReconnectNow` component, `exhausted` gate), [WatchRoute.test.tsx](/absolute/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1570/apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.test.tsx) (two new `#1570` tests plus three one-line assertions in existing tests), [together/testids.ts](/absolute/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1570/apps/web/src/together/testids.ts), [e2e/support/testids.ts](/absolute/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1570/e2e/support/testids.ts), and [apps/web/README.md](/absolute/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1570/apps/web/README.md). No ruling was needed (watcher-initiated retry is client UI; no rule or server behavior changes), so no `R<digits>` token was written.

How I tested it: `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` succeeded, then `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/together/WatchRoute.test.tsx` gave 18/18 passing (16 existing plus the 2 new), `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` were clean, `cargo jackioh spec check` reported ok (1066 rulings, 2424 proofs), `cargo fmt --check` was clean, and `git status` shows only the five files.

Decisions the issue did not settle (kept the planner's defaults): a click starts a full new round of `WATCH_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS` automatic reopens rather than a single attempt, per "resets the attempt counter"; and the waiting-panel button is `button-primary` while the status-line one is `link-button` matching `match.tsx`.

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 1 of 3.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 45.7 min | green | approve |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 5s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 0s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 1s |

</details>

Comment `@jgoetzmann-bot <what to change>` or `/harness revise <notes>` to ask for a revision, or `/harness stop` to stop it.
